title: 描眉画目：私人定制纹绣与眉形设计
title_en: Miaomeihuamu: a private studio for individual design
intro: 描眉画目·定制美学是一家以个人审美和专业眉形设计为核心的私人定制纹绣工作室，主打仪器野生眉。
intro_en: Miaomeihuamu is a private cosmetic-pigmentation studio centred on personal aesthetic judgement and individual brow design, with instrument hair-stroke brows as its main service.

sections.title: 设计从人开始
sections.description: 看五官立体度与量感、颧骨、眉眶骨、原生眉和个人喜好，尽量顺应原有骨骼结构，通过眉形轮廓与线条寻求视觉协调。
sections.description_en: Facial depth and visual weight, cheekbones, the brow bone, existing brows and personal preferences inform the design. Contour and strokes work with the existing structure to seek visual balance.

sections.title: 实际项目
sections.description: 提供手工野生眉、画派单仪器野生眉、画派双仪器初绒野生眉、丝雾眉、绒雾眉、美瞳线、扩唇、改乌唇、纹发际线与纹人中窝。具体适用情况先评估。
sections.description_en: Services include manual, single-instrument and dual-instrument hair-stroke brows, silk-shaded and velvet-shaded brows, lash-line enhancement, lip-contour refinement, dark-lip correction, hairline pigmentation and philtrum shading. Each requires a suitability assessment.

sections.title: 工作室与预约
sections.description: 乐乐老师2016年进入纹绣行业，2024年8月开设工作室。本人一对一设计操作，到店设计免费约30–45分钟，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Lele entered the field in 2016 and opened the studio in August 2024. She designs and performs the work personally, one client at a time. The design consultation is free, takes about 30–45 minutes, and all services include free touch-ups within one year.
